concentrate_sales.label: Mining concentrator (concentrate sales, process plant, freight)

lines.name: Concentrate sales (net)
lines.note: Concentrate shipped in tonnes (the vessels loaded out of the shed), not the mill's output. Price per tonne is one net figure you type: grade x payable x metal price - treatment and refining charges (TC/RC). Do not deduct freight here: the Freight row below prices it once. The 2026 copper TC/RC benchmark is $0/dmt and 0 cents/lb (S&P Global 2025 settlement, Dec 2024; SMM 2026 benchmark). linked_share is the sold share. A shortfall in shipments lowers this line once: the energy model's lost-production penalty on the concentrate bus is dropped, not charged on top.

lines.name: Process plant cost
lines.note: Per tonne of ore milled, typed: type the milled tonnes a year the results show, not the concentrate tonnes. This line does not scale with a shipment shortfall: if the mill runs less, lower the quantity yourself. No sourced split, so no default. Reference only, not a default: US$5.58-11.26 per tonne milled in 2025 reports (Project Blue, 'Digging into copper costs', 2024-25; secondary source; USD, not converted). The energy model already prices the plant's electricity, so enter the non-energy part.

lines.name: Freight
lines.note: Per tonne of concentrate shipped (road, rail, port, vessel to the smelter), priced here only: the sales price above is before freight. No sourced default: enter the price.

lines.name: Plant capex
lines.note: Plant capex not in the energy model's asset capex (crushing, mills, flotation, shed, buildings): the base of maintenance and insurance. Capex is priced once: do not re-enter the PV, battery or grid assets. No sourced default: enter the price and life.

lines.name: Staff
lines.note: FTE count per year. No sourced default: enter the quantity and the price.

lines.name: Maintenance
lines.note: Share of the plant capex above per year. No sourced default for a concentrator: enter the share.

lines.name: Insurance
lines.note: Share of the plant capex above per year. No sourced default for a concentrator: enter the share.
